Find Your Ancestor's Regiment

Search by state, or by a commander's surname, to narrow down which of the 467 Union and Confederate regiments and batteries at Gettysburg your ancestor may have served in.

This searches regiment and commanding-officer records only -- the roughly 165,000 individual soldiers who fought here aren't part of this site's dataset. Once you've narrowed down a likely regiment by state, the National Park Service's own Civil War Soldiers and Sailors System is the real place to search for an individual name.
